scenario.name: reschedule_appointment
scenario.goal: Reschedule a Monday appointment to sometime later that week or next week
scenario.context: Has a work conflict that just came up on Monday
scenario.personality: Professional, direct, slightly stressed, wants it resolved fast
scenario.notes: Be clear you need to move the Monday appointment. Ask what slots are available.
